packageRules.description: Astro core and its integrations move together, so update them in one PR
Tailwind and its Vite plugin are version-locked to each other
Group GitHub Actions bumps into a single PR
Auto-merge low-risk devDependency patches once CI passes
astro check is incompatible with TypeScript 7 until it ships a programmatic API (TS7.1+). See https://github.com/withastro/roadmap/discussions/1321
